title: Rose Mosaic Dream
description: A young woman with short dark hair sits on a teal and yellow sofa in a living room, holding a small object while looking toward the viewer. The wall behind her is covered in an elaborate mosaic of circular patterns, roses, and floral motifs in shades of pink, red, teal and blue, with floating pink bubbles and petals throughout the space.
prompt: A young woman with short dark hair wearing a pink sweater sits on a modern teal and yellow sofa in a cozy living room. She holds a small object in her lap. Behind her, an entire wall is covered in intricate mosaic artwork featuring large roses, circular patterns, and floral designs in pink, red, teal and blue tiles. Pink bubbles and rose petals float through the air. A wooden coffee table with a glass of water and a lamp on a side table are visible. Warm, soft lighting comes from a large window showing green foliage outside.
